segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on your admin profile?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Jordan at Northline Fabrication. Email is jordan.mills@northlinefab.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Great, I have your account up. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We need to add five more user seats for the ops team. We're at 42 right now, and we'd like to go to 47 starting today if possible.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure. I’m in the admin console now. Your current plan supports that, and billing is monthly on the 12th. The prorated amount for the five seats through March 11 is $186.25, then your monthly total goes from $1,554.00 to $1,739.00. Is that okay to apply?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that matches what I expected. Please use the card already on file.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Done. The account now has 47 seats available, and I’ve sent the receipt to billing@northlinefab.com. You can invite the five users from Admin, then Users, then Add user. They’ll get the setup email right away.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. I see the seat count updated on my side. That's all I needed, thanks.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Happy to help. I also added a note in ticket 482917 with the seat change and billing amount, so you have a record of it.
